cards.example_en: I think the blue shoes look better with that dress.
cards.example_zh: 我觉得那双蓝鞋配那条裙子更好看。

cards.example_en: I am thirsty after the run.
cards.example_zh: 跑完步我很渴。

cards.example_en: This bag is too heavy for me.
cards.example_zh: 这个包对我来说太重了。

cards.example_en: Those birds are flying south.
cards.example_zh: 那些鸟正在往南飞。

cards.example_en: Though it was cold, we went out.
cards.example_zh: 虽然很冷，我们还是出去了。

cards.example_en: A worrying thought kept me awake past midnight.
cards.example_zh: 一个令人不安的想法让我过了午夜还睡不着。

cards.example_en: Hot lemon water eased my throat while I had a cold.
cards.example_zh: 我感冒的时候，热柠檬水缓解了喉咙的不适。

cards.example_en: We walked through the quiet forest.
cards.example_zh: 我们穿过了安静的森林。

cards.example_en: Don't throw paper onto the grass beside the court.
cards.example_zh: 不要把纸扔到球场旁边的草地上。

cards.example_en: Thunder followed the flash of light.
cards.example_zh: 闪电之后响起了雷声。

cards.example_en: I bought a ticket for the school play.
cards.example_zh: 我买了一张校园剧的票。

cards.example_en: Please keep your desk tidy before the exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试前请保持课桌整洁。

cards.example_en: Remember to tie your laces before you join the race.
cards.example_zh: 参加赛跑前记得把鞋带系好。

cards.example_en: The tiger rested beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 老虎在河边休息。

cards.example_en: Check the time so we do not miss the coach.
cards.example_zh: 看一下时间，免得我们错过长途汽车。

cards.example_en: A tiny spider sat on the kitchen window frame.
cards.example_zh: 一只极小的蜘蛛停在厨房的窗框上。

cards.example_en: Dad came home tired after the night shift.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸上完夜班，回到家时已经很累了。

cards.example_en: I walk to school every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我每天早上步行去学校。

cards.example_en: Today is sports day, so lessons finish at noon.
cards.example_zh: 今天是运动会，所以上课到中午就结束。

cards.example_en: We cooked tofu with vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 我们用豆腐炒了蔬菜。

cards.example_en: We study English together after school.
cards.example_zh: 我们放学后一起学英语。

cards.example_en: The toilet is down the hall.
cards.example_zh: 厕所在走廊那头。

cards.example_en: Cut the tomato into small pieces.
cards.example_zh: 把西红柿切成小块。

cards.example_en: Tomorrow is too soon for such a long hike.
cards.example_zh: 这么长的徒步，明天就出发实在太赶了。

cards.example_en: The truck carried one ton of rice.
cards.example_zh: 卡车运了一吨米。

cards.example_en: Tonight is parents' evening in the main hall.
cards.example_zh: 今晚学校主礼堂举行家长会。

cards.example_en: This soup is too hot to drink.
cards.example_zh: 这汤太烫了，没法喝。

cards.example_en: Bring a small tool if the tent pole will not fit.
cards.example_zh: 如果帐篷杆装不上，就带一把小工具来。

cards.example_en: The baby got a new tooth and cried all evening.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝长了一颗新牙，哭了整整一个晚上。

cards.example_en: She got the top score on Friday's maths test.
cards.example_zh: 她在星期五的数学测验中得了最高分。

cards.example_en: The total cost of the picnic food was twenty yuan.
cards.example_zh: 野餐的食物总共花了二十元。

cards.example_en: Even a light touch on his arm made him jump.
cards.example_zh: 哪怕轻轻碰一下他的胳膊，他都会吓得跳起来。

cards.example_en: We went on a tour of the old town.
cards.example_zh: 我们参观了老城区。

cards.example_en: The tourist photographed the bridge from the bus.
cards.example_zh: 那位旅游者从公共汽车上拍下了那座桥。

cards.example_en: The children ran towards the ice cream shop after school.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们放学后朝冰淇淋店跑去。

cards.example_en: From the tower we could see the whole harbour.
cards.example_zh: 从高塔上，我们能看见整个港口。

cards.example_en: Shops in this town close early on winter evenings.
cards.example_zh: 冬天的晚上，这座城镇里的商店关得很早。

cards.example_en: The puppy chewed the rubber toy until it split.
cards.example_zh: 小狗把那个橡胶玩具啃到裂开了。

cards.example_en: Wool trade kept the harbour busy for years.
cards.example_zh: 羊毛贸易让这个港口热闹了好多年。

cards.example_en: Lighting lanterns is a tradition in her hometown.
cards.example_zh: 点灯笼是她家乡的一项传统。

cards.example_en: The traffic is heavy in the morning.
cards.example_zh: 早上交通拥堵。

cards.example_en: The club will train new swimmers this term.
cards.example_zh: 俱乐部这学期将训练新来的游泳队员。

cards.example_en: Football training starts after school today.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练今天下课后开始。

cards.example_en: Can you translate this menu so my aunt can order?
cards.example_zh: 你能翻译这份菜单，好让我阿姨点菜吗？

cards.example_en: We travel by train when we visit my uncle's city.
cards.example_zh: 我们去叔叔所在的城市时坐火车旅行。

cards.example_en: The story is about a hidden treasure.
cards.example_zh: 这个故事讲的是一份隐藏的宝藏。

cards.example_en: Nurses treat small cuts in the school medical room.
cards.example_zh: 护士在学校医务室里治疗小伤口。

cards.example_en: A tall tree shades our picnic table in the park.
cards.example_zh: 公园里一棵高高的树遮住了我们的野餐桌。

cards.example_en: Our class trip to the museum is next Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 我们班去博物馆的旅程定在下周四。

cards.example_en: Tom was in trouble after he broke the window.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆打破窗户之后惹上了麻烦。

word.example_en: I cannot think of his name.
Can you think up a game for the party?
word.example_zh: 你能为聚会想出一个游戏吗？

word.example_en: Think over the offer tonight.
word.example_zh: 今晚仔细考虑这个提议。

word.example_en: Think about the question before you answer.
word.example_zh: 回答前先考虑这个问题。

word.example_en: Think twice before you spend all your money.
word.example_zh: 把钱全花掉之前要三思。

word.example_en: She is thirsty for a chance to travel.
We will go even if it rains.
She has to go through the form again.
word.example_zh: 她得再仔细看一遍表格。

word.example_en: I cannot get through to the office.
word.example_zh: 我打不通办公室的电话。

word.example_en: I look through the paper before breakfast.
We got to the hall in time for the talk.
word.example_zh: 我们及时赶到礼堂听讲座。

word.example_en: The train left on time.
Please come in two at a time.
The baby cried all the time on the bus.
word.example_zh: 宝宝在公交车上一直哭。

word.example_en: I was ten at that time.
I am tired of the same lunch every day.
word.example_zh: 我厌烦每天吃同样的午饭。

word.example_en: The class starts at a quarter past eight.
The family will get together on New Year's Day.
The match is the day after tomorrow.
The soup is too hot to drink.
The tickets cost sixty yuan in total.
I will get in touch with the coach.
I keep in touch with my primary teacher.
word.example_zh: 我和小学老师保持联系。

word.example_en: My uncle comes by train.
Ask a teacher if you are in trouble.
word.example_zh: 如果遇到麻烦，就去问老师。
